description: This course is designed for graduate students in mathematics, and students in computer science and philosophy who have sufficient mathematical background. The core of the course is Gödel’s incompleteness theorem. Before that, some basic knowledge on first order logic, such as compactness theorem and properties of reducts of number theory, will be discussed. After that, some basic topics in Recursion Theory and Model Theory are introduced.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN (( must have completed MA4207 at a grade of at least A) OR ( must have completed MA3205 at a grade of at least A))
prerequisiteAdvisory: There is no prerequisites required for graduate students. Undergraduate students not meeting the prerequisite can seek departmental approval to enrol.
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN ((COURSES MA4207:A) OR (COURSES MA3205:A))
title: Logic and Foundation of Mathematics I
